name: Silfab Solar Inc.
old_description: Our superior-quality solar products deliver maximum power density, long-term reliability and are backed by one of the most trusted warranties in the industry.
about:
Silfab Solar Inc. operates its U.S. manufacturing headquarters in Burlington, Washington, with additional production facilities in Fort Mill, South Carolina, and a corporate office in Mississauga, Ontario. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it identifies as a North American solar manufacturer with three domestic factories.

Silfab designs and manufactures photovoltaic modules for residential, commercial, and utility-scale markets. Its product lines include the Elite Series (back-contact technology, up to 420 W), Prime Series (black-on-black residential panels up to 440 W), Commercial Series (high-power-density modules up to 590 W), and Utility NTC bifacial panels (up to 640 W, nearly 23% efficiency). All three North American plants run fully automated production lines with advanced robotics and hold ISO 9001:2015 certification.

The company sells through distributors and installers across the United States and Canada. Its panels have been deployed in projects such as the YWCA Bellingham historic preservation retrofit, the Suquamish Tribe's solar-plus-storage installation, Infinity Drain's commercial rooftop in Massachusetts, Fisherman's Pavilion community solar in California, Brave & Maiden Estate in Oregon, and the SWIF RACK commercial array in Grants Pass, Oregon.

Silfab emphasizes that its panels are engineered specifically for North American climate conditions, citing low defect rates and one of the industry's most comprehensive warranties—25-year product and 30-year linear performance coverage on the Utility series. The Elite Series is marketed as exclusively made in the USA, using conductive backsheet and integrated cell designs to maximize light capture.

name: Silfex Inc
old_description: We are the leading provider of precision silicon components used to make and operate semiconductor manufacturing equipment – which enable the trillion-dollar global electronics industry.
about:
Silfex Inc was founded in 2006 in Eaton, Ohio, as a division of Lam Research Corporation. The company began as a specialized supplier of precision silicon components for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

The company grows and machines custom silicon components, including plasma distribution products, for semiconductor processing and test applications. Its capabilities encompass silicon crystal growing, precision machining with a focus on accuracy and reproducibility for etch uniformity, and advanced damage-free hole drilling. Silfex describes its facility as the world's largest custom silicon components growing and manufacturing operation, though specific facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Silfex serves the semiconductor equipment industry, providing components used in the manufacture of devices ranging from smartphones to solar panels. Its customers include semiconductor equipment makers and adjacent high-technology markets. The company works with customers and suppliers globally.

Silfex emphasizes collaboration to deliver high-quality products and processes, positioning its components as critical for enabling the global electronics industry. The company's stated differentiation lies in its precision machining capabilities that support etch uniformity and wafer quality.

name: Silgan Plastics Corporation
old_description: Silgan Plastics specializes in two-step preforms, the cornerstone of high-quality plastic containers. Through meticulous injection molding, heating, stretching, and blowing processes, we create versatile preforms that cater to diverse packaging needs. Our expertise ensures consistent outcomes, reflecting our commitment to precision and innovation.
about:
Silgan Plastics Corporation operates from Flora, Illinois. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in public materials. It focuses on plastic packaging manufacturing.

The company produces plastic bottles, jars, containers, closures, and two-step preforms using injection molding, heating, stretching, and blow molding processes. It maintains multiple Commercial Development Centers across North America staffed with product engineers and molding technology. Its catalog includes over 30 automotive mold-available items and more than 800 other mold-available choices.

Silgan serves industries including automotive (motor oil and automotive bottles), personal care, healthcare, food and beverage, household, industrial chemicals, agriculture, home care, over-the-counter health, pet care, spirits, and wipes. Customers range from brands seeking custom packaging to those using stock or mold-available designs.

The company emphasizes rapid-to-market, cost-effective innovation, supported by in-house decoration, design, and engineering services. It also highlights sustainability practices across its production process, from manufacturing to shipping.

name: Silicon Forest Electronics, Inc
old_description: For the latest news, capabilities and solutions, visit Impact
about:
Silicon Forest Electronics was founded in 1999 in Vancouver, Washington. The company, now operating as Impact ES–Vancouver under the parent company Impact Electronic Solutions, began as a full-service electronics manufacturing services provider.

The facility delivers prototype and full-turnkey production services, including surface mount technology (SMT) and through-hole assembly, functional and environmental testing, new product introduction support, specialty processes, and electro-mechanical box build. Additional offerings encompass design and engineering services, printed circuit board assembly, cable and wire harness assembly, fiber optic cable assembly, and IPC training. The operation is part of a multisite network that includes locations in Clearwater, Florida; Cranston, Rhode Island; Grants Pass, Oregon; Vancouver, Washington; and Ventura, California.

Customers span medical and life sciences, military and defense, aerospace, unmanned systems, industrial and instrumentation, autonomous and robotics, commercial and industrial, and space sectors. The company serves original equipment manufacturers and other businesses requiring electronic manufacturing services across these industries.

The firm emphasizes service, quality, and innovation, positioning itself as a problem-solving partner that embraces complex engineering challenges and delivers practical solutions. All original certifications have been retained and expanded through the integration with Impact Electronic Solutions, which the company says provides an even broader range of compliance credentials.

name: Silicon Hills Design
old_description: Much more than a build-to-order contract manufacturer of printed circuit boards,
about:
Silicon Hills Design operates from Austin, Texas, as a PCB contract manufacturer and assembler. The company describes itself as a dedicated team of experts in material science, layout, manufacturing, logistics, and systems integration, going beyond build-to-order production.

Its core services include surface-mount (SMT) and plated-through-hole (PTH) circuit assembly, both RoHS-compliant and leaded, as well as full system integration covering cabling, functional testing, and programming. The firm also provides component sourcing through a cultivated supplier network, supporting projects from prototype to full-scale manufacturing with a lean, cross-functional team.

Silicon Hills serves customers in telecommunications, space, aviation, semiconductor tooling, industrial control, medical device, and computer markets. These clients are typically organizations developing high-technology products that require rapid, precise PCB assembly and system-level integration.

The company emphasizes quick turnaround, attention to detail, and a proactive, anticipatory approach to reduce time-to-market. Its stated differentiators are a proven sourcing network, expert SMT and PTH assembly, and end-to-end concept-to-product service that coordinates subsystems and vendors.

name: Silicon Integration
old_description: Integration was founded in 1996, and we offer complete turn-key and consignment
about:
Silicon Integration was founded in 1996 in Milford, Connecticut. The company operates as an electronic contract manufacturer.

The company specializes in printed circuit board assembly, offering high-volume low-cost production, high-mix low-to-medium volume runs, and quick-turn prototypes. Its services extend to turn-key and consignment assembly, new product introduction (NPI), system assembly, testing, fulfillment, hardware and software design, schematic capture, PCB layout, material management, and modifications. The facility handles advanced package placement including ball grid arrays (BGA) and employs degreed engineers. Component sensitivity procedures such as baking and sealing are also performed.

Silicon Integration serves customers in telecommunications, industrial, consumer, medical, trading, academic, and broadcast industries. The company works with original equipment manufacturers and other businesses requiring electronic manufacturing services.

The company emphasizes manufacturing principles, advanced technologies, and state-of-the-art software tools to help customers reduce time-to-market and increase profitability. It highlights its degreed engineering staff, RoHS compliance solutions, and integrated quality system as key differentiators.

name: Silicon Mountain Contract Services
old_description: At Silicon Mountain we strive to support our customers through superior service and high quality product.
about:
Silicon Mountain Contract Services operates from Nampa, Idaho, in the Pacific Northwest. The company describes itself as an electronics contract manufacturer focused on customer-oriented service, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

It provides printed circuit board assembly from prototype through high-volume production, using surface-mount and through-hole processes. The facility runs multiple pick-and-place lines (Advantis3 and Fuzion platforms), stencil printers (Speedprint SP700), selective soldering systems (Pillarhouse Orissa Synchrodex and Nordson Cerno 102), reflow ovens (Vitronics Soltec XPM3m), a radial insertion machine (Radial 88HTi), automated optical inspection (AOI ScanSpection), and conformal coating (SCS). Additional services include design-for-manufacturing analysis and global component procurement.

Customers span military and aerospace, medical devices, consumer electronics, and transportation electronics, as well as startups needing rapid prototyping. The company emphasizes flexibility and quick turnaround to help clients reach market faster.

Silicon Mountain highlights its ISO 9001:2015 certification, RoHS-compliant lead-free operation, and a design-for-manufacturing report intended to reduce cost and time. Its location near I-84 provides eight-hour truck access to Seattle, Salt Lake City, and Sacramento, supporting cost-effective shipping across the U.S.

name: Silicon Ranch Corporation
old_description: the world’s first solar company-owned flock of sheep to further expand our capacity to implement regenerative grazing across more acres on our solar farms. This flock took residence at Snipesville Ranch and during the 2023 lambing season, our dedicated team of agrivoltaic technicians ushered in 850 newborn lambs there. As a result, combined with an additional 300+ sheep we purchased, our flock has more than doubled in total size since 2022, from just under 1,000 to over 2,000, making it among the largest sheep flocks in Georgia. All of our sheep are now thriving in the “solar savannahs” created by our solar panels as they restore healthy soil, biodiversity, water, and  ecosystems.
about:
Silicon Ranch Corporation, headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, began operations in 2011 with two employees. The company pioneered utility-scale solar development in the Southeast, commissioning the first such projects in Tennessee, Georgia, Mississippi, Arkansas, and Kentucky. It remains privately held, with no public disclosure of individual founders.

The firm develops, owns, and operates utility-scale solar and battery storage projects across 15 states, with more than 4,000 megawatts in operation and over 5 gigawatts contracted. Its integrated model covers planning, construction, operations, and eventual decommissioning. In addition to power generation, Silicon Ranch runs a regenerative land management program that grazes more than 2,000 sheep and cattle on project sites, supported by a proprietary CattleTracker™ system and a 26,000-square-foot lambing barn at the Houston Solar Project.

Customers include electric utilities and cooperatives such as BrightRidge and Georgia Power, commercial and industrial partners like Volkswagen and Aerojet Rocketdyne, and landowners who lease acreage for solar farms. The company also serves corporate buyers through Clearloop, a subsidiary that sells carbon reclamation tied to new solar construction.

Silicon Ranch differentiates itself by retaining long-term ownership of every project, a record of delivering every power purchase agreement since inception, and a focus on restoring soil health and biodiversity through agrivoltaics. Partnerships with SOLARCYCLE for module recycling and with First Solar and Nextracker for domestic equipment sourcing further underscore its supply-chain commitments.

name: Siltronic Corporation
old_description: As one of the leading providers of high tech wafer solutions, Siltronic operates globally and maintains production sites in Asia, Europe, and the USA.
about:
Siltronic Corporation is headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and operates as the U.S. arm of Siltronic AG, a German-headquartered silicon wafer manufacturer that has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2015. The company maintains production sites across Asia, Europe, and the United States, serving the global semiconductor supply chain.

Siltronic manufactures high-tech silicon wafers that form the foundation for integrated circuits used in servers, computers, smartphones, electric vehicles, and wind turbines. With approximately 4,300 employees worldwide, the company runs multiple fabrication facilities in Asia, Europe, and the USA, though specific plant sizes and annual wafer volumes are not disclosed publicly.

The company’s customers are primarily semiconductor device makers and electronics original equipment manufacturers in the data-center, consumer-electronics, automotive, and renewable-energy sectors. Siltronic emphasizes close collaboration with these partners to align wafer specifications with evolving chip designs.

Siltronic states that its differentiation rests on a focus on quality, technology, innovation, and operational excellence, combined with an internationally positioned, customer-proximate production network. The firm also highlights strong supplier partnerships as a pillar of its strategy for the digital future.

old_description: Our staff is there to ensure you have an enjoyable experience. They have decades of experience between them, so don't be afraid to get your questions answered! about:
Simco Automotive Inc. operates from Houston, Texas, with additional branches in Dallas and Beaumont. The company has served the aftermarket automotive industry for over two decades, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names have not been made public.

The business functions as a wholesaler and distributor of aftermarket auto body parts, cooling products, and lighting components. Its inventory includes front bumper covers, fenders, headlights, radiator fan assemblies, and condenser fan assemblies for vehicles such as the Honda Accord, Toyota Tundra, and Jeep Grand Cherokee. Simco stocks parts certified by NSF and CAPA and emphasizes a dependable delivery network across Texas.

The company supplies collision repair shops, dealerships, and independent buyers throughout Texas. Its catalog covers a range of makes and models, with parts identified by Partslink numbers, and the firm positions itself as a resource for both professional installers and retail customers.

Simco cites its membership in the Aftermarket Body Parts Association (ABPA) as a way to stay current with industry trends. The company’s stated mission is to become the provider of aftermarket automotive parts in Texas by combining competitive pricing, high‑quality brand parts, and responsive customer service.
